snippet.title: Local Game Store Simulator Official Trailer #2
snippet.description:
Wishlist Local Game Store Simulator on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5322900/Local_Game_Store_Simulator/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=trailer

Coming to PC on December 10th, 2026.

Run your own local game store. Buy wholesale, crack packs, grade chase cards, haggle over trade-ins and price against a living market. Play solo, co-op or as rival stores. Change the rules of every game, and build your own cards, packs, games and consoles to sell and share on Steam Workshop.

Discord: https://discord.gg/8pQs4w5NA
Developed and published by Wild Peanut LLC

#LocalGameStoreSimulator #IndieGame #SimulationGame #TCG #CardShop #ShopSimulator #TradingCardGame #PCGaming #Steam #GameTrailer
